r 136 96 184 96 0 ${R1}

207 496 208 528 208 0 VOUT
a 304 208 400 208 9 ${VOH} ${VOL} 1000000 0 0 100000
w 304 192 224 192 0
w 224 96 224 144 0
w 224 144 224 192 0
w 184 96 224 96 0
w 136 96 96 96 0
w 184 144 224 144 0
w 136 144 96 144 0

w 136 192 96 192 0
w 304 224 272 224 0

w 272 288 336 288 0
w 384 288 448 288 0

o 9 4 0 4098 ${VR} 0.01 0 1
